title: Brooklake Country Club & Events

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Set on 150 acres with floor-to-ceiling views and a lakefront patio, Brooklake is an indoor-outdoor setting for standout fundraisers, corporate celebrations, seminars, and showcases. Our in-house planner orchestrates setup, décor, and flow; on the day, a seasoned service team anticipates every need so you can focus on guests and goals. In Morris County near North Jersey hubs, we host marquee occasions for up to 350 guests. Galas, award dinners, investor receptions, and charity gatherings that feel important - and taste extraordinary. Picture chef-curated antipasto and charcuterie displays, chef-attended stations, and beautifully paced plated courses when your program calls for it, paired

blurb: Brooklake in Florham Park, New Jersey brings together lakeside views, a light filled ballroom, and outdoor spaces that feel both polished and welcoming. Weddings, mitzvahs, showers, teen events, and corporate gatherings all benefit from a setting that feels private yet easy for guests to reach.
